scope: Portable managed replay of independently read public Windows ETLs. This is not native Windows reader, TDH, ProcessTrace, UTC, symbolization, or acquisition-completeness validation.

build.note: Build was invoked after the final empty-template fix. Replay start/finish timestamps and assembly hashes identify the executed build. The SDK can retain earlier timestamps for unchanged incremental outputs.

public_corpus.external_reference_reader: dissect.etl 3.14, independent AGPL-licensed tool; not copied or linked

path_mapping.${CORPUS_DIR}: Temporary corpus directory outside the checkout. Local absolute paths were replaced only in saved summary metadata; output_sha256 still refers to the original unmodified replay JSONL.

limitations: No TraceLogging records were present in the large or CLR-only replay inputs. The replay helper skips them when present and cannot validate native TL decoding.
Raw conservation checks do not establish property correctness. Independently compared field counts are in the classic, CLR-baseline and stack reports.
The 271 empty-template records remain decoding errors with all 425 payload bytes explicitly undescribed; the supplied manifest is not a complete schema.
PerfView performance/test traces do not represent incident-response provider/version coverage.
replayed_source_state: Application and replay helper .cs/.csproj matched the recorded source commit at replay time. Later edits to validation tools or documentation do not change the executed assemblies identified below.
